prompt: A new camera position in the same place as the first image. The lens is low down in the damp grass just behind one rear corner of the dented boxy grey robot from the second image (six chunky black wheels, amber beacon on its stalk, ragged faded bunting on a wheel). Her back fills the near foreground, soft at the edges, as she crawls over the turf towards the bunker. Dull overcast daylight, the beacon the single warm note. Shot like a 1980s BBC drama on 16mm stock, washed-out colour, gentle contrast, thick grain. Widescreen, nothing written anywhere in the frame.
